remarks: Discover your personal oasis in the sought-after Riverturn Complex! This spacious, move-in ready townhouse is just what you're looking for. With two-bedrooms, 2 1/2 baths, this home offers spaciousness, privacy AND convenience all in one! Enjoy the many recent upgrades - new paint and carpet throughout, new countertop in the kitchen as well as a new dishwasher, refrigerator and fixtures. New washing machine, three new toilets as well as bathroom fixtures. The roof on the building was replaced a month ago and there are also two new skylights (solar powered). Enjoy the inviting flow of the open concept of the main level and the extra space offered by the upper-level loft -- perfect for a home office, play area and more. Spend time in the bright and open living room complete with gas fireplace and then open the sliders to the gorgeous deck (recently refinished) overlooking tranquil, nature scenery. Two spacious bedrooms provide for comfort and privacy. Both bedrooms are en-suite. The primary bathroom has a double vanity. Need more space? Check out the finished basement - spacious and private with seamless access to the garage, mechanicals and storage. The home offers ALL of this - AND is walking distance to shopping, restaurants and more. Close access to the Merritt Parkway. Come check it out!
